violation_type.title: Discipline - Appropriate to Child's Age and Level of Understanding (26 TAC §744.2103(a)(3))
violation_type.short_title: Discipline - Appropriate to Child's Age and Level of Understanding
violation_type.typical_finding: This standard was evaluated and found to be out of compliance. It was found that a caregiver yells at the children when redirecting their behavior.

finding_variants.text: This standard was evaluated and found to be out of compliance. It was found that a caregiver yells at the children when redirecting their behavior.
A child with special care needs was given two written discipline forms and a total of 3 days suspension that was not to his level of understanding.
